worked_example.problem: A bottle has two symbols: a flame and an exclamation mark. What do they tell you, and how should you use it?
steps: The flame: the liquid catches fire easily, so keep it away from Bunsen burners and sparks.
The exclamation mark: it is harmful or irritating, so avoid touching it or breathing it in.
worked_example.answer: Flammable and harmful: no flames near it, and avoid contact.

cards.idea: A flame means flammable; a skull and crossbones means toxic; liquid on a hand and metal means corrosive.
example: Ethanol bottle: a flame. Keep it away from the Bunsen burner.

cards.idea: A flame over a circle means oxidising; an exclamation mark means harmful or irritant; an exploding bomb means explosive.
example: Potassium manganate(VII) is an oxidiser: keep it away from fuels.

cards.idea: Read the label before you open a bottle. Never mix chemicals unless the teacher says so.
example: Two harmless-looking liquids can react and give off a poisonous gas.

check.prompt: What should you do before opening a reagent bottle?

right.text: Read the label and the hazard symbols.

wrong.text: Smell it to find out what it is.
wrong.explain: Never smell chemicals directly: some give off harmful gases.
Never taste anything in a laboratory.
Shaking can spill or splash: read the label first.

questions.prompt: Match each hazard symbol (described in words) with its meaning.

pool.left: liquid dripping onto a hand and a metal bar

pool.right: oxidising: makes other things burn more fiercely

pool.left: a dead tree and a dead fish

pick.why: A bottle of concentrated sulfuric acid carries the symbol for “corrosive: destroys skin and metal”.
A bottle of sodium hydroxide carries the symbol for “corrosive: destroys skin and metal”.
A bottle of ethanol (methylated spirit) carries the symbol for “flammable: catches fire easily”.
A bottle of kerosene carries the symbol for “flammable: catches fire easily”.
A bottle of mercury carries the symbol for “toxic: poisonous”.

pick.a: oxidising: makes other things burn more fiercely
pick.why: A bottle of potassium manganate(VII) (permanganate) carries the symbol for “oxidising: makes other things burn more fiercely”.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A flame over a circle means oxidising.

wrong.text: The skull and crossbones means flammable.
wrong.explain: The skull and crossbones means toxic (poisonous). A flame means flammable.

wrong.text: A corrosive liquid is safe on skin.
wrong.explain: Corrosive substances destroy skin: wash any splash with lots of water and tell the teacher.
